seat.note: Republican Sen. Susan Collins sought a sixth term; the original Democratic nominee, Graham Platner, withdrew in July 2026 and Troy Jackson replaced him with about 100 days left.

nomineesSource: Collins was unopposed in the June 9, 2026 Republican primary; Graham Platner won the Democratic primary that day but withdrew in July after a Politico report of a sexual assault allegation, and Maine Democratic Party delegates chose Troy Jackson as the replacement nominee. Only write-in candidates joined them on the ballot.
